item.title: DNA doesn’t lie! Delhi HC upholds POCSO Conviction of father who impregnated minor daughter
item.description: “The social circumstances and the economic status of the family may have compelled the Prosecutrix and her mother to give contradictory statements or to turn hostile. However, in such cases the Court cannot completely ignore the scientific evidence which has come on record.” The post DNA doesn’t lie! Delhi HC upholds POCSO Conviction of father who impregnated minor daughter appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Call for Abstracts | NLUT-UEM International Conference on Sustainable North-East India, 2026

item.title: Railway employee travelling on Privilege Pass held bona fide passenger; Bombay HC grants Rs 3 lakh compensation despite missing journey entries
item.description: “Merely because an employee holding a valid pass fails to mention details himself, it cannot be held that he was travelling without a valid pass.” The post Railway employee travelling on Privilege Pass held bona fide passenger; Bombay HC grants Rs 3 lakh compensation despite missing journey entries appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi High Court restrains large-scale job scam involving misuse of “AKASA AIR” trademark; issues directives
item.description: “The balance of convenience lies in favour of the Plaintiff, and if the Defendants are not restrained, the Plaintiff would suffer irreparable injury which cannot be adequately compensated in terms of money.” The post Delhi High Court restrains large-scale job scam involving misuse of “AKASA AIR” trademark; issues directives appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: ‘Granting maintenance would be grave injustice’; Allahabad HC denies woman’s claim after her brother shot her husband, leaving him incapacitated
item.description: “If a wife, by her own acts or omissions, causes or contributes to the incapacity of her husband to earn, she cannot be permitted to take advantage of such a situation and claim maintenance.” The post ‘Granting maintenance would be grave injustice’; Allahabad HC denies woman’s claim after her brother shot her husband, leaving him incapacitated appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: “Way forward is not radical reinvention but institutional course correction”: Justice N.V. Ramana speaks at Day 1 of the 4th ILA Conference
item.description: Day 1 of the much-awaited 4th ILA Conference featured erudite addresses and insights from leading insolvency experts and distinguished dignitaries on insolvency law and policy, global trends in restructuring, the changing geopolitical landscape, and cinema as a lens and mirror for the economy.
